_about: Where each model named in the network spec actually runs. 'map' reroutes a spec model; 'fallback' serves any model that is neither routed nor installed. OpenRouter retries the configured open-weight alternatives on 429/5xx responses. 'onboarding' is the model the onboarding assistant uses. The first route is the default.

openrouter.description: Open-weight models on OpenRouter with automatic fallback on rate limits. Needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY and internet.

hybrid.description: Departments run locally; only the Farm Director uses a large free cloud model.

local.description: Everything on this laptop through Ollama. No internet needed.

local-api-test.description: Tests the cloud code path against local Ollama's OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
